description: Community Sopro V2 Turbo (samuel-vitorino/sopro-v2-turbo): a 120M zero-shot voice-cloning TTS. SentencePiece text tokenizer, style-prefix conditioned autoregressive semantic LM over FSQ tokens, rectified-flow acoustic DiT and a Vocos ISTFT vocoder at 24 kHz.

request.name: language
request.description: Language tag (en, pt, fr, de); omitted inherits transcript language, then the session default.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Semantic sampling temperature; nonpositive selects greedy decoding. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.temperature.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Semantic nucleus cutoff; values outside [0,1] are disabled/clamped by the sampler. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.top_p.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Semantic top-k; nonpositive disables filtering. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.top_k.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Positive acoustic sampling steps; omitted uses checkpoint generation.steps.

request.name: max_duration_sec
request.description: Positive maximum segment duration; must be >= min_duration_sec. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.max_seconds.

request.name: min_duration_sec
request.description: Nonnegative minimum duration; must be <= max_duration_sec. Omitted uses checkpoint generation.min_seconds.

request.name: reference_duration_sec
request.description: Positive reference window in seconds; omitted uses checkpoint generation.ref_seconds.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Positive codepoint budget per segment; omitted uses checkpoint generation.max_segment_chars.

request.name: seed
request.description: Non-negative seed for semantic sampling and the acoustic noise prior; omit for a random seed.

session.name: language
session.description: Default language tag for requests that do not set one.

session.name: voice_cache_slots
session.description: Reference voices kept prepared between requests, so a repeated voice skips the encoders and, when streaming, the prompt solve. Output is identical with or without it. A streamed 10 s voice holds about 60 MB. Default 0 (off).

session.name: matmul_weight_type
session.description: Storage type for the matmul weights of every stage (semantic LM, acoustic DiT, encoders, vocoder head).

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Storage type for convolution weights (speaker/semantic encoders and the Vocos backbone).

packages.description: Single-file GGUF of all four stages with the config and tokenizer embedded: f16 weights, mel front ends kept in f32.
Upstream checkpoint from samuel-vitorino/sopro-v2-turbo: config.json, tokenizer.model and the four safetensors stages. Runs directly, no conversion needed.
